text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp has arrived at<n>last.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In addition to training, there are also<n>plenty of
events<n>happening—everything from a beach<n>day to a
fireworks show... The school<n>even planned a
barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm off, so time me, okay? ...Hey, you<n>listening?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. Sit in the shade while you time<n>me. And drink
some water. I don't<n>want to have to redo my laps
'cause<n>you passed out.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'd like to think Air Shakur and I havegrown closer since the beginning. Butwhether or not she trusts me...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Well, summer is always jam-packed<n>with events,
so this is the perfect time<n>to deepen our bond!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Or at least, that's what I had hoped...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A day at the beach? Unless it's for<n>training, no way
am I spending time in<n>this heat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A fireworks show? What a lame,<n>loud, and illogical
idea. Pass.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not happening.
choice_data_list: But... I haven't said anything yet!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're inviting me to the school<n>barbecue. It's so
obvious. What's<n>next, the pool? Camping? Get
your<n>summer-loving head out of the<n>clouds,
moooron.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I know you're up to something, so<n>give it up. I'm
not doing anything<n>outside of training.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All that cheerful laughter is just noise<n>to me, plain
and simple. You should<n>know that by now.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Air Shakur doesn't like<n>noisy places.
Perhaps I should have<n>considered that when finding
events<n>to invite her to.
choice_data_list: Well, that doesn't mean I should give up!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Surely there must be a summer<n>activity Air Shakur
would like... As I<n>stare ahead in thought, a spark of
light flutters in the distance, before<n>disappearing
again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Watching the fireflies would make the<n>perfect
peaceful summer activity! One<n>that I'm sure Air
Shakur will enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, I head in the direction I saw<n>the firefly,
and my nights spent<n>searching for their gathering
space<n>begin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it's been days since<n>then, and my
search has yet to prove<n>fruitful...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I start to wonder if I was seeing<n>things that day.
This river looks<n>perfect for fireflies, but I've yet to
see a single one.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just as I begin to think it better to give<n>up for this
year, I feel a hand on my<n>shoulder.

Stop right there, stranger. Let's see<n>some ID... That
reminds me, I've<n>gotten reports of a weirdo
stalking the<n>woods late at night.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Goootcha.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You've been acting weird all day. You<n>think I
wouldn't notice?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Now, what're you up to?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'd better fess up... I<n>explain my quest
for fireflies and the<n>reason behind it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now it's fireflies, huh? I thought<n>you'd been too
quiet lately... When<n>are you gonna learn?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought I told you. I don't need all<n>this
buddy-buddy stuff. I already—
choice_data_list: I know, I know. You already have Parcae.
I know, I know. You already have Parcae.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't get it. If you know, then whycan't you just accept it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought it was pity or a<n>sense of
superiority, but I don't think<n>that's it. It's
something else.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So why do all this? Conviction? A<n>sense of duty?
Some weird new<n>training technique I'm unaware
of?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The answer comes to me surprisingly<n>quick.
choice_data_list: I just care about you. That's all.
I just care about you. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I explain that I know Air Shakur<n>already has the
perfect partner in her<n>PC. No doubt that's the
reason she<n>was able to get this far without<n>trouble.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But if she continues to avoid relyingon others, I can't help but worryabout what will happen when shedoes encounter trouble she can'thandle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she pushes people away even<n>then, whatever
that trouble is, it could<n>stop her in her tracks.
choice_data_list: That's why I want us to get closer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha... So this improbable possibility<n>you've come up
with is the reason<n>you've been inviting me to every
little<n>thing?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You got us kicked out of a net cafe,<n>inserted
yourself into my shopping...<n>and wandered around
in the dark<n>hunting bugs for that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What were you going to do if thispissed me off more? It would'veended in a lot more than me pushingyou away.
choice_data_list: I know you wouldn't let it get that far.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur is anything but timid. If Ireally made her mad, she would havesimply found another trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... So annoying.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You talk like you know what you're<n>doing, yet here
you are, worrying<n>about something that isn't even
guaranteed to happen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's so illogical. Just like everything<n>you do.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...And fireflies prefer darker places<n>than this. The
ground is too hard, and<n>there's not enough grass.
Did you<n>even check upstream?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur turns and heads in the<n>opposite direction
of camp. For a<n>second I think to correct her, but
something stops me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You coming or not? Watching fireflies<n>doesn't
sound so bad.
